t: Flomasta PipeGrip Lever Isolating Valve offers a simple push-fit solution for isolating water flow in 15mm pipework. Featuring a lever action and dual locking system, it ensures secure, leak-free operation with no hot works required. WRAS approved and compatible with plastic and copper pipe, it’s ideal for quick and easy isolation in tight spaces.
b: Lever Action: Easy On/Off Control for Isolation
No Hot Works: Quick & Safe Installation
Universal Compatibility: Works with Both Copper & Plastic
